Comment: Meridian ingest pipeline. The deployable Amazon States Language definition matching src/pipeline/ingest-workflow.ts. Deployed by infra/terraform/modules/step-functions.

PrepareConnectorList.Comment: The vendors THIS carrier runs - one GPS unit, one ELD, one dashcam. Kept in the definition so onboarding a vendor is a Terraform change with an audit trail, not a code deploy. Per-tenant subsets live in DynamoDB; this is the default.

CollectFromProviders.Comment: Fan out one Lambda per vendor. MaxConcurrency 4 keeps us inside every vendor rate limit. ToleratedFailurePercentage lets the run succeed on partial data - a dead dashcam feed must not block position data.

Retry.Comment: Vendor throttling and 5xx. Full jitter is applied inside the Lambda as well - Step Functions backoff alone still synchronises retries across parallel branches.

Catch.Comment: Never fail the whole run for one vendor.

NormaliseToTelemetry.Comment: Vendor payloads -> canonical Telemetry[]. Pure function; safe to retry.

ResolveTerritory.Comment: Which district and geofences does this point fall in. Best-effort: an ELD reports a clock and has no coordinates at all, so failure continues rather than aborts. The hot path does a bbox pre-filter in memory against geofences cached at module scope - a PostGIS round trip per ping is neither fast nor cheap at 11,000/sec.

AnyTelemetry.Comment: A quiet polling window is a success, not a failure.

EvaluateRules.Comment: Per-driver deterministic rules -> Exception[], and fold the newest position into hot state. No LLM here on purpose: what pages a human at 4am must be identical every time and explainable to the person it woke.

DetectIncidents.Comment: Corroborate and merge exceptions into incidents. Two independent vendors before raising, and one road closure is one incident with fourteen drivers rather than fourteen pages.

PersistAndPublish.Comment: BatchWriteItem to DynamoDB, then PutEvents to EventBridge. Write before publish, so a subscriber that immediately queries cannot 404. NOTE what is published: exceptions and incidents only. Telemetry is persisted and folded into hot state but never reaches the bus - at 11,000 readings/sec it would make bus cost scale with fleet size instead of with incidents.

NotifyFailure.Comment: Terminal failure path. Publishes to EventBridge so alerting is a rule, not hard-wired here.

FailExecution.Cause: See the IngestFailed event and the execution history for detail.
